facts.fact: The Smart Zambia Institute has begun engaging an international partner to strengthen local capacity; its coordinator says the system will be developed by Zambians with the partner's technical support.

facts.fact: Zambia's national digital identification system has entered a key implementation phase, funded under the Digital Zambia Acceleration Project by a US$100 million IDA grant, with completion targeted for 2026, says ZNBC.
